basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 22-year-old student from Toronto, Canada. I'm currently studying computer science and have a keen interest in online gaming, especially on platforms like Roblox. In my spare time, I enjoy trading in Adopt Me, which is how I stumbled upon this subreddit. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after classes. My dislikes include toxic behavior and unfair trades. Outside of gaming, I'm interested in enhancing my tech skills and exploring new software.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been into gaming since I was a teenager, and over the years, I've developed a solid understanding of trading dynamics in virtual environments. My knowledge primarily comes from personal experience and community interactions, and I'm continuously learning from guides and forums.
